description: This is an implementation class for user-related services in a Java Spring application, handling user retrieval, deletion, listing, and saving/updating operations, utilizing DAO and other service dependencies.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for user-related business services, extending a generic service implementation, and implementing UserService interface.

methods.name: UserServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that injects UserDao dependency and passes it to superclass.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User by username using UserDao.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user after fetching the full entity by ID.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Lists all users, handling exceptions by wrapping in ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists users associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new user or updates an existing user based on ID presence.
